knowledge_state: NEW UNFAMILIAR SCRIPT. Source references are STYLE_ONLY. Both depiction and science content are original to this brief.

original_content.script_excerpt: A pulse begins deep below the ground. Each rock layer carries it differently. At the boundary the pulse changes direction, and a sensor on the surface receives it later.
original_content.scene_goal: In one clear original cross-section image, make a viewer recognize a connected underground fracture, two distinct solid rock layers, one bent luminous wave path crossing their boundary, and a surface sensor tied to that path. The image is a canonical state for a future animated refraction, not an entire movie.

a surface sensor on a soil anchor
